_about: A made-up sample plan, nobody's own: the coach's self-check reads it in place of plan-data.json on a vault with no plan yet, so the plan check, the draft review, plan-write and a draft's sessions still run there.

warmups.lift: 5 min easy bike · 2 light sets of the first lift

A.name: Goblet squat
A.note: Why: the main squat, with dumbbells only.

A.name: Dumbbell lateral raise
A.note: Why: side delts, which the presses train little.

A.name: Front plank
A.note: Why: core, braced as for the squat.

B.name: Dumbbell reverse lunge
B.note: Why: single-leg work for the quads and glutes.

S1.name: Dead bug
S1.note: Why: core on the short day.

S1.name: Easy bike (zone 2)
S1.note: Why: easy aerobic work; talk in full sentences.

Goblet squat.setup: Hold one dumbbell at the chest, feet a little wider than the hips.
Goblet squat.do: Sit down between the heels, then stand.

Flat dumbbell bench press.setup: Lie on a flat bench, a dumbbell in each hand over the chest.
Flat dumbbell bench press.do: Lower to the chest's sides, then press up.

Dumbbell lateral raise.setup: Stand tall, a light dumbbell in each hand.
Dumbbell lateral raise.do: Raise the arms out to shoulder height, then lower slowly.

Front plank.setup: Forearms on the floor, elbows under the shoulders.
Front plank.do: Hold a straight line from head to heels.

Dumbbell Romanian deadlift.setup: Stand with a dumbbell in each hand.
Dumbbell Romanian deadlift.do: Push the hips back with a flat back, then stand.

One-arm dumbbell row.setup: One hand and knee on a bench, the dumbbell in the other hand.
One-arm dumbbell row.do: Pull the elbow back to the hip, then lower.

Dumbbell reverse lunge.setup: Stand with a dumbbell in each hand.
Dumbbell reverse lunge.do: Step back and lower the back knee, then return.

Side plank.do: Lift the hips and hold a straight line.

Dead bug.setup: On the back, arms up, knees over the hips.
Dead bug.do: Lower the opposite arm and leg, then return.

Easy bike (zone 2).do: Pedal at a pace you can talk at.
